metrics: Physical retailers globally are facing increased pressure from e-commerce and raised customer expectations.

“Working with Microsoft has become the backbone that federates teams for a fruitful and well-synchronized co-selling approach around the world.” Guillaume Portier, Executive Vice President, Global Partner Management, VusionGroup The global retail industry faces growing pressure Representing more than 20% of the world’s GDP, physical commerce is the world’s largest industry.
Not surprisingly, the industry is always under massive pressure – facing price wars, inflation, increases of costs and taxes – which makes sustaining profits over time challenging for retailers.
VusionGroup is the world leader in IoT & Data solutions for physical commerce, serving over 350 large retailer groups around the world in Europe, Asia, and North America.

The company unlocks higher economic performance, facilitates seamless collaboration across the value chain, enhances the shopping experience, creates better jobs, cultivates healthier communities, and significantly reduces waste and carbon emissions.
“There are over 20 million stores globally, which has a massive impact on society.

Retailers can turn physical stores into ultra-efficient local fulfillment centers of online orders, so they can identify the right store and product availability in real-time for every online order, leading to shortened delivery time and reduced carbon emissions.

These technologies allow retailers to control costs and improve inventory turnover with real-time visibility and actionable insights, enabling them to maximize on-shelf availability, using automatic monitoring, alerts, and re-orders.
